_README: SCHEDULED MACRO EVENTS. Edit this file — the app re-reads it whenever it changes, no restart.
WHY YOU HAVE TO MAINTAIN THIS: there is no free API for central-bank and statistics-release
calendars. Rather than invent dates, the app reads them from here and tells you plainly when
the file has gone stale. An entry marked "unverified": true is one the app shipped with and
you have NOT confirmed — the dashboard flags it until you set it to false.
VERIFY AGAINST THE SOURCE, then set unverified to false:
FOMC   https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm
US CPI https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm
RBI    https://www.rbi.org.in  (MPC meeting schedule)
NFP is NOT listed here — it is the first Friday of every month by rule, so the app derives it
and it can never go stale.
FIELDS
at        ISO-8601 UTC instant of the release. Convert from the source's local time.
(8:30am US Eastern = 12:30Z in summer, 13:30Z in winter.)
kind      fomc | cpi | nfp | rbi | other
impact    high | medium — only 'high' blocks new leveraged entries; 'medium' only warns
label     what shows on screen
unverified  true until you have checked it against the source above
validThrough: once today passes this date the app reports the calendar STALE and DROPS its
events rather than showing last year's schedule as upcoming. Extend it when you add dates.
blockHoursBefore / blockHoursAfter: the window around a high-impact release in which new
leveraged entries are blocked.
